type: Research candidate list, not an implementation task or authorized asset-generation backlog
instructions: Before producing an icon, confirm its feature is required by current Chunks PRODUCT/UX/specs; research-only competitor features do not imply a new product requirement.
Check docs/design/svg/master-inventory.json and docs/design/svg/icons/catalog.json again against live main; a draft may have been added since this research.
Use original Chunks-specific SVG geometry and approved visual language. Competitor art is a visual reference, never source to copy.
Keep alternatives and owner decisions explicit. Do not replace approved icons without owner visual approval.
Report SVG path, variants/states, screenshots/16-24-32px inspection, and library registration; do not alter app runtime without a separate implementation task.
